title: Neuromodulation: an atlas of exogenous drives, from coupling to outcome

creators.name: Adamek, Daniel
creators.affiliation: The University of Alabama in Huntsville

description: An interactive, volumed atlas of how exogenous drives (brain and nerve stimulation, focused ultrasound, light and drugs) act on the nervous system, from coupling to outcome, with a graph lab over every mechanism claim the review makes. This release is Volume 0 (Foundations): 16 sections, 263 references, 300 glossary terms, 18 levelled 101s, nine figures and 458 cited claims in a claims-only graph, of which 119 are contested and nine are null results. It is a commissioned review by Daniel Adamek, drafted with AI assistance under the author's direction. It is not peer reviewed. Its literature sweep closed on 15 September 2026. The app code is MIT-licensed; the content (the content pack, the data generated from it, the graph exports and the rendered text and figures) is licensed CC BY 4.0.
